    Aggregate Raw Bike Snapshots to Dock Level

    aggregate_snapshots.Rd

    Takes the raw three-column movement data (one row per bike per timestamp) and collapses it to one row per dock per timestamp, counting the number of bikes currently at each dock. Rows where DOCID == "0" (bikes in transit) are excluded from dock counts. The resulting data frame is the input expected by get_bike_availability() and get_slot_availability().

    aggregate_snapshots(snapshots, stations, default_capacity = 30L)

    Arguments

    snapshots

    A data frame with columns BIKEID (character), DOCID (character), and time (POSIXct or character). Produced by simulate_data.R or loaded with readRDS() / read.csv().

    stations

    A data frame with at least a dockID column (character) and optionally capacity (integer, docking slots available), name, lat, lon. Loaded from data/stations/<city>.csv. If capacity is not present, a default value is assumed (see default_capacity).

    default_capacity

    Integer. Capacity to assume for any dock not present in stations or missing a capacity value. Defaults to 30, which matches the simulation setup in simulate_data.R.

    Value

    A data frame with columns:

    DOCID

    Character. Dock identifier (matches stations$dockID).

    time

    POSIXct. Snapshot timestamp.

    bikes

    Integer. Number of bikes at this dock at this timestamp.

    capacity

    Integer. Total docking slots at this dock.

    Author

    Big Red Crew

    Examples

    if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
movement  <- readRDS("data/jersey_city.rds")
stations  <- read.csv("data/stations/jersey_city.csv",
                       colClasses = "character")
dock_data <- aggregate_snapshots(movement, stations)
head(dock_data)
} # }
